title: mimi-mls: join_welcome stores then deletes a refused group (crash window)
description: krmn K4: OpenMLS StagedWelcome exposes only the joiner's own leaf, so join_welcome checks the full tree after into_group stores the group and deletes it again (MlsGroup::delete) on refusal. A crash between store and delete leaves a refused group in the store; a later Member::load would load it. Options: find an OpenMLS accessor for the staged tree (fork change) to check before into_group; or mark the group pending until checked; or document as a Limitation. Low risk, P3.
